trickyParts: The stall proxy keeps reading and discarding on both sockets of a frozen connection and never closes either, so nats.js's stale close never blocks on a full buffer; connections opened after freeze() forward, stallNext(n) freezes the next n from their first byte.
envoy-stack builds natsd and the listener once per concurrently running set of stacks and the last stop removes the binaries, because bun test fires no process exit event to clean up on.

Claude Code's plugin_version comes from the plugin-cache path segment (installedPluginVersion(process.argv[1])), passed into startChannelSession as a required ChannelSessionOptions.pluginVersion; package.json's 1.0.0 is never reported.
Measured row A is always ~30.0 s because the freeze comes right after a ping, the worst case of the 3 x 10 s window.
deviations: natsConnectionOptions takes servers as readonly string[] and copies it, so callers pass natsUrls without spreading.
The plugin name is read from each package manifest's name (simplify pass), not a string literal; the value sent is unchanged.
No pi-legion test needed changing: its registration assertions match partially.
